body:
I think we've spent a lot of time debating this - if pushed my preference was Edgeware.Network, but if not available this makes sense.

I actually think we are on a path to breaking out the Edgeware main domain into separate entities, simply because you cannot explain all of Edgeware on one site - it just becomes unwieldy - and since it is an open source / public project, people are free to establish their own sites that help them bring alive a particular narrative or direction.

Kind of the same as we now have multiple Edgeware accounts on Twitter - is there an 'official one'?
Very good news! We should definitely go for this.
